title: Logos 10 opening: consubstantial — further defense
english: Tenth discourse. That the Son is consubstantial with the Father — further defense against the Christ-fighters’ readings.
Cyril continues the homoousios case so that shared glory and works are not emptied into unlikeness.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
